title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: tighten data residency controls for customer-managed KMS keys by enforcing region pinning at RBAC v2 evaluation time and improving audit logging to make key selection and region constraints observable. This PR implements an opt-in enforcement flag (rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning) with a migration to surface existing policy violations, adds structured audit events for KMS key resolution and region decisions, and hardens evaluation paths to prevent silent cross-region fallbacks. Changes include runtime checks, admin CLI migration helpers, additional unit/integration tests, and docs. Checklist: - [x] Implement enforcement toggle and evaluation guards - [x] Emit structured audit events for KMS resolution and region pinning decisions - [x] Migration script to detect existing policies that rely on unconstrained keys - [x] Add unit tests and integration tests covering cross-region and fallback scenarios - [x] Update docs and release notes - [x] Security review and threat model update Related Linear: ENG-1423, SEC-88. See internal design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1423/enforce-kms-region-pinning (internal). This description is a single continuous string.

docs: add security KMS residency section
review_comments: Marco Silva: Can you add a unit test covering KMS key with missing region metadata? Without this we might silently fall back to a global key.
Priya Natarajan: Added kms_region_missing_test and updated key resolver to return explicit error when region is absent. See latest commit.
Alicia Gomez: Audit event schema looks good, but please include key_id in cleartext only in admin-audit logs (redact in tenant-level logs).
Priya Natarajan: Implemented redaction by default and added admin_only flag to the audit event. Updated docs.
Ethan Park: Integration tests flaky on first run (timeout in canary infra). Reran CI and tests passed.
Marco Silva: Approved and verified migration script output on staging. Good to squash-merge after SEC signoff.
release_notes: Security: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 evaluations (config: rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning).
Audit: Emit structured audit events for KMS key resolution and region decisions. Admin logs include key_id; tenant logs redact key identifiers.
Tooling: CLI migration to detect policies that may violate region residency; migration prints remediation steps.
Tests: Added unit and integration tests covering cross-region fallbacks and missing-region keys.
notes: Operational notes: rollout plan requires toggling rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning=false in prod for a canary subset, run migration CLI to identify affected policies, update policy or key metadata to include region, then flip to true. Monitoring: new audit metrics 'audit.kms.region_pin.violations' and alert when >5 violations/hour during rollout.
